Steps: 1. Open /auth/register 2. Enter Tushaar Gupta + unique email + Valid#12345 3. Submit
ExpectedResult: User is redirected to login page

Title: Login and verify profile information
Steps: 1. Login with registered credentials 2. Open Account > Profile 3. Check first name last name email
ExpectedResult: Profile shows Tushaar Gupta and registered email

Title: Multi-item cart quantity update then CoD confirm×2 shows invoice
Steps: 1. Add 2+ products 2. Open cart 3. Increase qty on one line and verify total changes 4. Proceed cart → sign-in → address → payment 5. Cash on Delivery 6. Confirm twice 7. Open My Invoices
ExpectedResult: Cart total recalculates; invoice listed under My Invoices

Title: Register with already-used email is rejected
Steps: 1. Open register 2. Submit form using existing email
ExpectedResult: Error shown; user not registered again

Title: Checkout blocked with incomplete billing address
Steps: 1. Clear/edit street city postal house to empty 2. Observe Proceed to payment
ExpectedResult: Proceed stays disabled; payment step not reached

Title: Single Confirm does not generate invoice yet
Preconditions: Logged-in user at payment CoD step
Steps: 1. Select Cash on Delivery 2. Click Confirm once only 3. Check payment page and My Invoices
ExpectedResult: Payment success may show; no invoice number; My Invoices still empty
